title: RWKV7 HIP backend (gfx1151)
description:
## Summary
Implement a high-throughput RWKV7 inference backend using ROCm/HIP kernels on gfx1151, with strong correctness parity tests and a backend abstraction that enables future CUDA/alternate backends.

## Primary Docs
- docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md
- docs/HIP_KERNEL_OPTIMIZATION_RESEARCH.md
- docs/HIP_MEMORY_LAYOUT.md
- docs/FIXTURE_GENERATION_SPEC.md
- docs/THEROCK_INSTALLATION.md

## Success Criteria
- [ ] HIP backend builds behind a `hip` feature flag.
- [ ] Phase 0–3 correctness tests pass (kernel, layer, and full-model parity vs fixtures).
- [ ] Streaming + chunked processing parity tests pass.
- [ ] Benchmarks exist (Phase 4) without correctness regressions.

title: Phase -1: Backend abstraction + decisions
description:
## Summary
Define a minimal backend abstraction surface area and decide the HIP integration approach so future CUDA/alternate backends can be added without rewriting model math.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (Phase -1)
- Existing runtime v7 implementation: src/runtime/v7.rs

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Backend integration approach decided (in-crate vs separate crates).
- [ ] Backend trait surface defined (device/context/stream, alloc, kernel launch, GEMM/GEMV hooks, basic ops).
- [ ] A dummy backend can compile to prove interface stability.
- [ ] HIP backend can be selected without changing model math/tests beyond backend selection.

title: P-1.1 Backend abstraction decision + API sketch
description:
## Summary
Decide the HIP integration approach and define the backend abstraction surface area (traits + module layout) needed to support HIP now and CUDA/alternate backends later.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (Phase -1)
- Existing engine is WebGPU-first; HIP will be behind a feature flag.

## Deliverables
- Decision record: in-crate backends vs separate crates.
- Proposed trait(s) covering context/stream, alloc (device/managed), kernel launch, GEMM/GEMV entrypoints, and required tensor ops.
- A minimal compile-only dummy backend implementation to prove the interface is workable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Architecture decision is written down (with tradeoffs).
- [ ] Backend trait/API compiles in the repo.
- [ ] Dummy backend compiles behind a feature flag.

title: P-1.2 Add HIP backend review + gaps doc
description:
## Summary
Add/restore the missing `docs/HIP_BACKEND_REVIEW_AND_GAPS.md` document referenced by the epic, capturing open decisions, risks, and integration gaps before deep implementation.

## Context
- Epic links currently reference `docs/HIP_BACKEND_REVIEW_AND_GAPS.md`, but the file is missing.
- This doc should stay in sync with the implementation plan.

## Deliverables
- `docs/HIP_BACKEND_REVIEW_AND_GAPS.md` with:
  - confirmed decisions (layout, precision, BLAS choice)
  - open questions (backend abstraction, cooperative launches, etc.)
  - known toolchain risks (ROCm/TheRock versions)
  - how to validate on gfx1151

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/HIP_BACKEND_REVIEW_AND_GAPS.md` exists and is linked from the epic.
- [ ] Doc clearly lists decisions vs open questions.
- [ ] Doc lists next validation steps on gfx1151.

title: Phase 0: Test infrastructure (fixtures + harness)
description:
## Summary
Establish the test-first foundation: generate Python golden fixtures and create a Rust harness to load/compare them.

## Context

- Fixture spec: docs/FIXTURE_GENERATION_SPEC.md

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Python fixture generation script exists and can produce kernel/layer/model fixtures.
- [ ] Rust test harness can load `.npz` fixtures and compare tensors with clear diffs.
- [ ] Harness self-tests pass.

title: 0.1 Python golden fixture generation (.npz)
description:
## Summary
Create a Python script to generate golden `.npz` fixtures from the RWKV-LM-V7 reference implementation for validating HIP kernel correctness.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (0.1 Reference Data Generation)
- Spec: docs/FIXTURE_GENERATION_SPEC.md
- Reference code lives under: repos/RWKV-LM-V7/

## Deliverables
- `scripts/generate_test_fixtures.py` (or equivalent) that emits the directory structure from the spec.
- `tests/fixtures/` structure (with `.gitignore` strategy if fixtures are too large to commit).
- Clear instructions for how to (re)generate fixtures (model download path, Python deps, seed).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Script runs successfully with the RWKV7 0.1B model.
- [ ] Fixtures generated for all kernel types listed in `docs/FIXTURE_GENERATION_SPEC.md`.
- [ ] Fixture format documented (tensor keys, `{name}_shape` arrays, flatten order matches backend convention).
- [ ] A stub Rust test can load at least one generated fixture file.
close_reason: Implemented Python fixture generation script and Rust test harness. All fixtures generated and verified loadable.

title: 0.2 Rust fixture harness + tensor comparison utilities
description:
## Summary
Add Rust test infrastructure for loading `.npz` fixtures and asserting tensor closeness with clear mismatch reports.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (0.2 Test Harness Setup)
- Fixture format: docs/FIXTURE_GENERATION_SPEC.md

## Deliverables
- `tests/common/` fixture loader (NPZ) and helper APIs.
- `assert_tensors_close*` utilities for f32/f16 with rtol/atol.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `TestFixture::load()` works with generated fixtures.
- [ ] `assert_tensors_close()` correctly identifies matching/mismatching tensors.
- [ ] Error messages identify the location/value of mismatches.
- [ ] Harness self-tests pass under `cargo test`.
close_reason: Implemented fixture loader and tensor comparison utilities with 24 passing self-tests

title: Phase 1: HIP foundation (build + context + tensor)
description:

## Success Criteria

- [ ] HIP context/device/stream lifecycle is implemented and tested.
- [ ] HIP tensor/buffer abstraction exists (device + managed allocations) and is tested.

title: 1.1 HIP project structure + build system
description:
## Summary
Add the `hip` feature flag and build plumbing (`build.rs` + minimal FFI) to compile and run a trivial HIP kernel from Rust.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (1.1 Project Structure + Build System)
- Toolchain guidance: docs/THEROCK_INSTALLATION.md

## Deliverables
- `hip` feature flag wired in Cargo.
- `build.rs` that compiles `.hip` sources (hipcc/amdclang++).
- A trivial kernel (e.g., copy) and a Rust wrapper to launch it.
- Minimal tests that validate the toolchain runs on GPU.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `cargo build --features hip` succeeds.
- [ ] `cargo test --features hip test_simple_kernel_runs` passes.
- [ ] Kernel executes on GPU (not just compiles).
close_reason: Implemented HIP build system with hipcc compilation, FFI wrapper, and passing tests

title: 1.3 HIP tensor/buffer abstraction
description:

- [ ] `test_tensor_copy_roundtrip` passes.
- [ ] `test_tensor_view_strides` passes.
close_reason: Implemented TensorHip with shape/stride handling, managed memory support, and view/slice capabilities. All 3 acceptance tests pass.

title: 3.5 Full model forward pass parity (0.1B)
description:
## Summary
Run the full RWKV7 forward pass on HIP (0.1B model) and validate logits parity vs Python fixtures.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (3.5 Full Model Forward Pass)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Logits match Python reference within tolerance for fixture cases.
- [ ] Works for both short and batched fixture scenarios (if provided).

title: 3.6 Streaming mode (token-by-token parity)
description:
## Summary
Add a streaming/token-by-token inference API with persistent state and validate that step-wise execution matches batched forward outputs.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (Streaming Mode)
- Fixtures: `tests/fixtures/model/streaming.npz` (and token-shift streaming fixtures)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Streaming `step()` matches batched forward results for fixture cases.
- [ ] Prompt ingestion + subsequent stepping matches reference outputs.
- [ ] State reset behavior is correct.

title: 3.7 Chunked processing (long context)
description:
## Summary
Implement chunked forward processing for long contexts (> chunk_size) while preserving state, and validate parity vs reference fixtures.

## Context
- Plan: docs/RWKV7_HIP_BACKEND_PLAN.md (Chunked Processing)
- Goal: memory scales with state, not full `[B, T, C]` activations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Chunked forward produces the same final logits as unchunked forward for fixture cases.
- [ ] State carries correctly across chunk boundaries.
- [ ] Chunk size is configurable (default suggested 4096).
